data.body_html:
Planning a stag weekend in Marbella and wondering about the Marbella boat rental stag weekend cost breakdown 2033? You’re in the right place. This guide gives you transparent, no-nonsense pricing for our fleet, so you can budget with confidence. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT — no hidden fees. Boats depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella’s nightlife and coastline.

How Much Does a Boat Rental Cost for a Stag Weekend in Marbella?

Our pricing is straightforward. For a typical stag group of 9–12 people, you have two main tiers:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39): €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Both are 12.5m, carry 9–11 passengers, and include all standard inclusions.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80, white or grey): €4,719 minimum for 4 hours, with a free jet ski. This 24m yacht fits 12 passengers and offers serious wow factor.
  • Other boats (e.g., Azimut 58, Ferretti 94, K80): Pricing on request via WhatsApp. These are larger or more luxurious, so contact us for a custom quote.

For a full breakdown of every boat, see our Marbella boat rental fleet page.

What’s Included in the Price?

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You won’t pay extra for fuel or insurance — it’s all baked in.

Optional extras (at additional cost) include: premium catering (barbecue, paella), extra crew (hostess), or water toys (SUP, snorkel gear). Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange.

Additional Costs to Budget For

Beyond the charter fee, plan for:

  • Crew gratuity: 10–15% of the charter fee, given at your discretion.
  • Transport to Puerto Banús: Taxis from Marbella centre cost around €15–20; from Málaga airport, €60–80.
  • Food and extra drinks: You can bring your own, or upgrade to a catered package (prices vary).
  • Optional jet ski or water sports: Only included free on the Mangusta 80. For other boats, ask for a quote.

Total spend for a 4-hour stag charter on a Tier A boat: around €749 + €75–€112 tip = €824–€861. For a full day: €2,299 + €230–€345 tip = €2,529–€2,644.

Which Boat Is Best for a Stag Weekend?

For a lively group of 9–11, the Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40 are excellent value. For a premium experience with space to party, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax, free jet ski) is the top choice. If you want something smaller and faster, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) is a sporty option. For a full list of boats, visit our Marbella boat rental fleet.

How to Book and Secure Your Date

To secure your preferred boat and date, we recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks in advance, especially for summer weekends (June–September). A 50% deposit is required, with the balance due 7 days before departure. Payment is via bank transfer or card. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and to customise your trip.

Sample Stag Weekend Itinerary (4-Hour Charter)

TimeActivity
14:00Meet at Puerto Banús, board your boat, safety briefing
14:15Depart, cruise past the Golden Mile and La Concha mountain
14:30Anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming and drinks
16:00Jet ski session (if on Mangusta 80) or paddleboarding
17:30Return cruise to Puerto Banús, music and drinks on board
18:00Disembark, head to Ocean Club or Pangea for nightlife

For longer charters, you can also visit Cabopino or Estepona coastline.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cheapest boat rental for a stag weekend in Marbella?

The cheapest option is our Tier A boats: the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, starting at €749 for 2 hours. Both are 12.5m, carry 9–11 passengers, and include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. For a full day (8 hours), the price is €2,299 per boat.

Are fuel and insurance included in the price?

Yes, absolutely. Every charter includes fuel, insurance, the licensed skipper, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). There are no hidden extras.

Can we bring our own food and drinks on board?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The standard package already includes a selection of drinks and snacks. If you want a catered upgrade (e.g., barbecue, paella), just ask via WhatsApp.

What is the maximum group size for a stag boat rental?

Our largest boats (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Ferretti 94, Canados 86) take up to 12 passengers. Smaller boats like the Bandido (8 pax) or Speedboat (6 pax) are better for intimate groups. Check the fleet page for exact capacities.

How much does a Mangusta 80 cost for a stag weekend?

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) costs €4,719 minimum for a 4-hour charter. This includes a free jet ski towed behind the boat. For longer durations, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp.

Do we need to tip the skipper?

Tipping is not mandatory but is customary. A typical gratuity is 10–15% of the charter fee, given at the end of the trip if you’re happy with the service. It’s not included in the advertised price.

Can we depart from a marina other than Puerto Banús?

All our boats are based at Puerto Banús. If you need a different departure point (e.g., Marbella Marina, Cabopino), we can sometimes arrange it for an additional fee. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss.

What happens if the weather is bad on our stag weekend?

We monitor weather closely. If conditions are unsafe, we’ll offer a full refund or reschedule at no extra cost. For marginal weather, the skipper may adjust the route. Your safety is the priority.
